messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.alerts.tally_gap - live token tally < shadow by ~10% for eu-central emitters starting ~2026-04-10T02:18Z. Potential false overage flags.
lara-oncall: taking pager. Paging @diego-billing and @pete-sre. Any recent deploys?
diego-billing: no deploys. I see 6 overage_flags for accounts in eu-central. Shadow ledger higher than live.
pete-sre: checking pipeline: kafka consumer group meter-consumer shows partition 5 lag=18000. Looks like emitter-ingest-5 stalled.
ops-bot: k8s: restarting pod/emitter-ingest-5 in eu-central cluster.
anya-cs: pausing outbound billing emails for eu-central now; CS notified affected customers with "investigating" message.
pete-sre: emitter logs show repeated "Heap space" errors then restarts. Restarted pod; consumer lag falling to ~1200.
diego-billing: recon plan: run billing-reconcile for window 2026-04-10T01:30Z-02:30Z, job=recon-1799994322-a. Will hold invoices until recon completes.
ops-bot: recon job recon-1799994322-a progress: queued -> running -> 60%
lara-oncall: set temporary rule: suppress automated overage emails for eu-central until recon finishes.
diego-billing: recon job finished: cleared flags for 6 accounts; no charges applied.
anya-cs: CS confirms customers received follow-up stating no charges were taken.
lara-oncall: root cause summary: single emitter consumer OOM -> delayed commits -> live tally lag -> automated overage flags. Actions: add JVM tuning, liveness probe, increase kafka commit timeout, add quick recon run as part of pager playbook.
pete-sre: created tasks SRE-2201 (heap tuning + probe) and SRE-2202 (auto-recon playbook).
incident-bot: Pager resolved: metering.alerts.tally_gap severity=P2 duration=57m
